There's something familiar about his facial\nexpression and the way he speaks. Could this guy\nbe...
A shadow that opened the forbidden door and dances\nin the dark night...Yes, I am the Forbidden\nShawle.
Forbidden? That's a weird name~. And what's with\nthat outfit?!
Everyone is busy now, you know? You should hurry\nback and help!
Actually, I had a fateful encounter that guided me\nand made me reconsider my true calling.
Xmas is a foolish and pointless event that weakens\npeople and and makes them lose their will to live.\nI've decided to rid the world of this scourge.
And I would like to begin by destroying Navida\nCity.
I'll also get rid of those who stand in my way\nincluding the adventurer, Velly, and the Xmas\nknights.
Y-you've got a lot of nerve saying something like\nthat!!
I'm not sure if Velly is the one I should get rid\nof first, cuz the others might become even more\ndetermined later and turn into a major obstacle...
Should I get rid of "Velly" first, or the\nadventurer? That's the question.
You think it's all just nonsense or a joke?
Hey, you've got to get a grip!
Settling things in such a chaotic situation or\nfrenzy is not my style...
I'm still in the process of building up my power,\nso there's no need to push myself too hard at this\npoint.
Agios, wait! It looks like that guy is actually\nShawle.
Nope, because I first heard about it from the\ngreat spirit...
It was also the great spirit who led me here to\nsave you from the danger you were facing.
So? Did the great spirit say anything?
Yeah, there's something I need to tell you...\nBut Nicola also needs to be treated. Let's go back\nto Navida for now!
